SPECIFICATION FOR 
EQUAL CROSS BODY FOR OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLING 

PART I MADE FROM FORGINGS 



1- Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for equal cross bodies made 
from forgings for use in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Material — Steel conforming to class 1A of IS : 1875-1978 ' Carbon steel billets, blooms, slabs and 
bars for forgings ( fourth revision ) ' or any other steel as agreed to between the user and the 
manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Equal bodies shall be phosphated to class A2 of IS : 3618-1866 'Phosphate 
treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion' unless otherwise agreed to between the user 
and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These equal cross bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with IS : 10417-1983 ' Equal cross 
coupling assembly for oil-hydraulic systems '. 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 ( Part f )-1978 ' General 
requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oii-hydrauiic system : Part I General \ 

6. Designation — An equal cross body of light series L for 6 mm outside diameter of tube and 
conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Equal Cross Body L 6 IS : 9746 ( Part I ) 

7. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers equal cross bodies made from forgings only. The bodies made from bar 
stock are covered in IS : 9746 ( Part II )-1981 ' Equal cross body for oil-hydraulic couplings : Part II 
Made from bar stock \ 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards; 

BS : 4368 Carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes 

Part I s 1972 Heavy series ( metric ) 

Part rif : 1974 Light series ( metric ), British Standards Institution ( BSI ) 

DIN 3951 : 1966 Non-soldered taper-bush type p'pe unions. Cross union for use with union nut. 
Deutsches Institut fiir Normung ( DIN )
